review_method.success_contract: Visible bilateral grasp, no table support, approximately >=5 cm lift, continuously >=0.5 seconds.
review_method.failure_rule: If no qualifying unsupported lift is visible, classify failure; missed approaches, top contacts, pushes, and closures away from the cube are missed_grasp.

decisions.visible_evidence: Cube remains table-supported while the gripper closes away from it; no qualifying lift is visible.
Repeated approaches miss the cube and it remains on the table throughout the reviewed timeline.
The gripper approaches beside the cube; the cube remains visibly table-supported with no lift.
The gripper closes offset from the cube; no unsupported cube motion or lift is visible.
Approaches and closures do not secure the cube; it remains on the task surface.
The gripper reaches near the cube but never establishes a bilateral grasp or unsupported lift.
Contact displaces the cube on the table; no bilateral grasp or lift follows.
Contact occurs without a secure grasp and the cube remains table-supported.
Linked replacement video shows closures offset from the cube and no qualifying lift.
Cube is visibly held between both fingers, unsupported and well above the table for more than 0.5 seconds.
The gripper closes away from the cube; the cube remains on the table throughout the reviewed timeline.
Approaches remain offset and no unsupported lift is visible.
The gripper passes beside the cube and closes without securing it; the cube remains supported.
A top/side contact pushes the cube, but no bilateral grasp or lift occurs.
The gripper closes offset from the cube; no qualifying unsupported lift is visible.
Repeated approaches fail to secure the cube and it remains on the task surface.
The gripper operates far from the cube; the cube remains table-supported.
The gripper closes with a large lateral offset and never lifts the cube.
Cube is visibly clamped between both fingers and elevated unsupported for at least 0.5 seconds.
The gripper closes beyond and beside the cube; no unsupported lift is visible.
Approaches do not establish a grasp; the cube remains table-supported throughout.
After an earlier top contact, a later attempt visibly clamps and lifts the cube unsupported for more than 0.5 seconds.
The gripper never secures the cube; no qualifying unsupported lift is visible.
